axis: Cannot be compressed to a known consulting phrase. Maximum lexical diversity. Doctrine-anchored phrasing.

patterns: ^.{0,200}(In an era where|It is widely (recognized|acknowledged)|In today.s (rapidly|fast-paced)|As we (look to|move into))
questions.question: REQUIRED: no template opening ('In an era where', 'It is widely recognized')?

patterns: \b(In closing|To summarize,|In summary,|In conclusion,|As we conclude|As mentioned earlier)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: no template closing ('In closing', 'To summarize', 'In conclusion')?
REQUIRED: no empty bullets ('drive value', 'enable transformation', 'unlock potential')?
At least 4 unique compound phrases (firmware-and-knowledge, fleet learning, etc.)?
REQUIRED: ≥2 named program/product terms unique to this proposal (Forge Edge, Forge Net, etc.)?

questions.pattern: (Bloomberg of|iOS of|App Store of|Stripe of|Tesla of|Linux of|GitHub of)
questions.question: REQUIRED: at least one specific extended metaphor (Bloomberg, iOS of CAN, etc.)?
REQUIRED: no consultant-packaging tokens (engagement-led, value-add, deliverable-rich)?
Optional: no recurring '3 things' / 'three pillars' bullet template?
REQUIRED: at least 2 specific dollar amounts in first 500 chars (anchored opening)?
